summary: The note describes a revival of searing with cast-iron skillets among chefs and home cooks since September 2023. It covers the Maillard reaction science, technique tips such as preheating and drying protein, skillet maintenance, creative uses beyond steak, seasonal produce, and community events built around cast-iron cooking.
one_line: Cast-iron skillet searing is enjoying a revival, driven by chefs, technique, maintenance know-how, seasonal produce and community events.
key_facts: Chefs and home cooks have increasingly embraced searing in cast-iron skillets since September 10th, 2023.
Emily Thornton, Head Chef at the New Age Culinary Institute since late 2023, calls the skillet 'a culinary heritage'; her 'Skillet Charms' masterclass sold out within hours in November.
The Maillard reaction is the chemical process that creates the deep brown crust on meat seared in a hot skillet and amplifies flavor.
Marco Diaz presented his 'Seared Sensation Series' at food festivals in early 2024 and praised the skillet's ability to go from stovetop to oven.
Sizzle & Iron, a New York-based restaurant, opened on January 15, 2024, and is known for its 'smoking hot' preheating philosophy.
Joshua Klein advises heating a skillet gradually then bringing it to high heat; it is ready when a flick of water sizzles and dances on the surface.
Klein also recommends patting protein dry, letting it come to room temperature, and not overcrowding the pan.
Anita Gomez, a Brooklyn-based cookware specialist, revives old cast-iron pieces; her maintenance workshops surged in popularity after the 'Cast-Iron Comeback' event on September 22, 2023.
Sofia Chang became known for cast-iron seared fish tacos since a Los Angeles pop-up last December, and also experiments with tofu and fruits for caramelization.
Chef Liam Russell gave a cast-iron vegetable searing demonstration at a local harvest fest on October 7, 2024.
Natalie Webb, a food blogger and event organizer, sets up neighborhood 'Skillet Swaps' and 'Sear-offs' to share recipes, techniques and meals.
